about: The link types of the library and their named inverses (section 2 of ARCHITECTURE.md). A link is stored once on the card that asserts it, as {rel, to}; where the target is a card the inverse is written on the target as {rel: inverse, to, inv: true}, so each connection is two directed edges. Generated by library.mjs 0.2.0 from build/lib/linktypes.mjs; each type's place in data/ontology.json (ontologist@'s) is read at every build.

links.use: the maker, from the git trailer or the first commit of the path
a finding in a pass, a file in a desk or an agent folder, a run report or inbox of an agent
a file names another card by path, address or pass name; each target is an existing card
what the card is about: a subject of vocabulary/subjects.json, or the entity (company, organisation, person, place, topic) its page is
the decision page a finding names, or the card where an answered question says it stands
a later holding replaces an earlier one (front matter, a versioned name, or the owner's word in authority/forms.json)
a generated file and the file its own header says it came from
related holdings worth reading together (two cards that cite each other, or the owner's word); written as two directed edges because the ontology bans a verb that is its own inverse
